category.name: discovery
category.description: Explore servers, cubes, dimensions, and members

tool.name: get_available_tm1_servers
tool.description: Retrieves a list of available TM1 server names
tool.returns: List of server names (strings)
tool.use_when: Starting any data analysis task, need to know available servers

tool.name: get_tm1_cubes
tool.description: Retrieves list of all cubes from a TM1 server with metadata
tool.returns: List of cube metadata objects (name, type, uniqueID, has_rules, has_drillthrough_rules, has_drill_processes, has_cell_security, is_locked)
tool.example: Input: {"server": "24Retail"} Output: [ { "id": "Revenue", "name": "Revenue", "type": "cube", "uniqueID": "570a069e-e452-4c06-994e-36dca2bcd3e3", "has_rules": true, "has_drillthrough_rules": true, "has_drill_processes": true, "has_cell_security": true, "is_locked": false } ]
tool.use_when: Need full cube metadata including rules, security, drill processes

tool.name: list_cubes_with_ai_analysis_metadata
tool.description: Retrieves cubes with AI analysis metadata, showing which are pre-analyzed

parameters.param: If true, only pre-analyzed cubes are listed

tool.returns: List of cube metadata with is_analyzed flag and optional AI summary
tool.use_when: CRITICAL: Check before using get_data_from_data_explorer to determine if cube is pre-analyzed

tool.name: get_cube_dimensions
tool.description: Retrieves list of dimension names for a cube
tool.returns: List of dimension names (strings)
tool.use_when: Need to understand cube structure before querying

tool.name: get_cube_dimensions_with_metadata
tool.description: Retrieves dimensions with full metadata including dimension type and unique IDs
tool.returns: List of dimension metadata (name, type, dimension_type like GEO/TIME/VERSIONS, uniqueID, default_hierarchy)
tool.use_when: Need dimension types (GEO, TIME, VERSIONS) or unique identifiers

tool.name: get_cube_sample_members
tool.description: Retrieves sample members from each dimension of a cube
tool.returns: List of sample members for each dimension (dimension_name, sample_members with id and optional alias)
tool.use_when: Need to see available members before constructing queries; use IDs in MDX, aliases for display
tool.important: Always use member IDs (not aliases) in MDX queries and tool parameters

tool.name: lookup_potential_members
tool.description: Searches for dimension members matching a search term

parameters.param: Specific dimension to search (if omitted, searches all)

tool.returns: List of matched members with dimension name, member ID, and optional alias, sorted by relevance
tool.use_when: User mentions a member name that might not be exact; need to find similar members

tool.name: get_cubes_that_may_answer_query
tool.description: Recommends cubes that may contain data to answer a natural language query
tool.returns: List of cube names with AI-generated summaries explaining relevance
tool.use_when: User hasn't specified cube but describes what data they need

tool.name: get_data_from_data_explorer
tool.description: Retrieves data using natural language query (ONLY works with pre-analyzed cubes)

parameters.param: Natural language query describing what to see
Cube name (optional, will auto-select if omitted)

returns.field: state: Encoded state for further analysis
alternative_cubes: Other cubes that might answer query

tool.use_when: Cube is pre-analyzed (check with list_cubes_with_ai_analysis_metadata first)

error_handling.error: If cube not pre-analyzed, returns error: "Cube [name] was not pre-analyzed"

tool.name: execute_mdx_and_get_view
tool.description: Executes MDX query directly (works with ANY cube, pre-analyzed or not)

returns.field: state: Encoded state for further analysis

tool.use_when: CRITICAL: Use when cube is NOT pre-analyzed, or when you need precise control over query
tool.important: This is the fallback when get_data_from_data_explorer fails

tool.name: get_MDX_for_recommended_view
tool.description: Generates MDX query from natural language (for non-pre-analyzed cubes)

parameters.param: Cube name (optional, will auto-select if omitted)

returns.field: alternative_cubes: Other cubes that might answer query (if cube was auto-selected)

tool.use_when: Want AI to construct MDX for you; alternative to manually writing MDX

category.name: analysis
category.description: Perform advanced analysis on cube data

tool.name: perform_impact_analysis
tool.description: Performs key drivers analysis to identify most influential data points

returns.field: results: List of key driver points with x,y coordinates
x_range: Range of x-axis values (min, max)
y_range: Range of y-axis values (min, max)

tool.use_when: Need to identify which data points have greatest impact on results
tool.follow_up: Use get_impact_analysis_summary to get natural language insights

tool.name: get_impact_analysis_summary
tool.description: Generates natural language summary from impact analysis results

parameters.param: List of key driver data points from impact analysis

tool.returns: Natural language summary explaining key drivers, their impact, and insights
tool.use_when: After perform_impact_analysis, to get human-readable insights

tool.name: perform_outlier_detection
tool.description: Detects anomalous data points using multiple algorithms

returns.field: results: List of algorithm results, each with outliers, algorithm name, score, summary

tool.use_when: Need to identify unusual or anomalous data points
tool.follow_up: Use get_outlier_summary for specific algorithm to get natural language explanation

tool.name: get_outlier_summary
tool.description: Generates natural language summary for outliers detected by specific algorithm
tool.returns: Natural language summary explaining outliers, patterns, and insights
tool.use_when: After perform_outlier_detection, to get detailed explanations for specific algorithm

tool.name: generate_exploration_analysis_report
tool.description: Generates comprehensive PDF report with visualizations and AI-generated insights
tool.returns: Base64-encoded PDF file with analysis report
tool.use_when: Need comprehensive report with visualizations for presentation or documentation

tool.name: create_tm1_cube
tool.description: Creates a new cube on TM1 server

parameters.param: List of dimension names (dimensions must already exist)

tool.returns: Success message
tool.use_when: Need to create new cube programmatically
tool.important: Dimensions must already exist on the server

tool.name: delete_tm1_cube
tool.description: Deletes an existing cube from TM1 server
tool.returns: Success message
tool.use_when: Need to delete cube programmatically
tool.warning: Permanent operation - confirm with user first

tool.name: save_mdx_view
tool.description: Saves a view to a cube using either MDX or view state

parameters.param: MDX query (required when not using state)
Encoded state (required when not using MDX)

tool.returns: Saved view metadata
tool.use_when: Need to persist a view for later use
tool.note: Provide either MDX or state, not both

tool.name: get_saved_view
tool.description: Retrieves a previously saved view

returns.field: state: Encoded state for further operations

tool.use_when: Need to load previously saved view

tool.name: list_cube_views
tool.description: Lists all views for a specific cube
tool.returns: List of view metadata (name, type, view_type, uniqueID)
tool.use_when: Need to see available views for a cube

category.name: process_management
category.description: Create, update, execute, and monitor TM1 TurboIntegrator processes

tool.name: get_tm1_processes
tool.description: Retrieves detailed list of TM1 processes with parameters and metadata
tool.returns: List of process objects with name, parameters, data types, default values
tool.use_when: Need to discover available processes or audit TM1 automation scripts

tool.name: get_tm1_process_details
tool.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for specific TM1 process including script logic
tool.returns: TIProcess object with full structure, parameters, procedures (Prolog, Metadata, Data, Epilog)
tool.use_when: Need to inspect process structure, debug, or understand existing automation

tool.name: create_tm1_process
tool.description: Creates new empty TM1 process on specified server
tool.returns: Created process details with empty procedures and no parameters
tool.use_when: Starting to build new TI process for dimension/cube creation or data loading
tool.note: Creates empty process - use update_tm1_process to add code

tool.name: update_tm1_process
tool.description: Updates existing TM1 process with procedure code and parameters

parameters.param: List of parameter objects with Name, Type, Value, Prompt

tool.returns: Response with syntax_errors array (empty if successful)
tool.use_when: Adding or modifying TI process code; validating syntax
tool.important: Check syntax_errors in response - must be empty for success

tool.name: delete_tm1_process
tool.description: Deletes existing TM1 process from server
tool.returns: Success message
tool.use_when: Cleaning up test processes or removing obsolete automation
tool.warning: Permanent operation - confirm with user first

tool.name: execute_tm1_processes_asynchronously
tool.description: Executes TM1 process asynchronously without waiting for completion

parameters.param: List of parameter objects with Name and Value

tool.returns: Immediate response indicating request was received
tool.use_when: Executing dimension/cube creation, data loading, or any TI process
tool.note: Non-blocking - use get_tm1_server_process_status to check completion

tool.name: get_tm1_server_process_threads
tool.description: Retrieves list of active user threads for process executions on server
tool.returns: List of active thread objects with type, function name, thread ID, metadata
tool.use_when: Monitoring server activity or checking for running processes

tool.name: get_tm1_server_process_status
tool.description: Retrieves current status of specific TM1 process execution
tool.returns: List of threads associated with process including ID, type, state (running, idle, etc.)
tool.use_when: Checking if asynchronously executed process has completed
tool.pattern: Poll this after execute_tm1_processes_asynchronously until state is not "running"

tool.name: cancel_tm1_process_execution
tool.description: Cancels running TM1 process execution
tool.returns: Response indicating cancellation result
tool.use_when: Need to stop long-running or problematic process

tool.name: get_tm1_server_process_execution_error_logs
tool.description: Retrieves latest execution or error log for a process
tool.returns: Content of latest log file (error or execution log)
tool.use_when: Debugging process failures or verifying successful execution
tool.success_indicator: Empty or no error logs found

guideline.step: 1. Call get_available_tm1_servers to see available servers
2. If user hasn't specified cube, call get_cubes_that_may_answer_query or list_cubes_with_ai_analysis_metadata
4. Call get_cube_sample_members to see available members

if_yes.step: Use get_data_from_data_explorer with natural language query

if_no.step: Option A: Use get_MDX_for_recommended_view to generate MDX, then execute_mdx_and_get_view
Option B: Construct MDX manually and use execute_mdx_and_get_view directly

guideline.when: User mentions member name that might not be exact
guideline.step: Present matches to user or use best match

guideline.prerequisite: Must have state from previous query (get_data_from_data_explorer or execute_mdx_and_get_view)
